title: nazm.references/1
description: Every occurrence of one entity in a compilation (N77), read from its modules' resolved units (`nazm.resolved/1`). One object on stdout from `nazm references DEF FILE`. A module whose check entry was reused contributes its stored unit and is not checked again; `checked` and `reused` say how many were.

module.description: The durable key of the module the bytes are in.

declaration.description: Where its name is declared, or null when no module of the compilation declares it in source.

uses.description: Every other occurrence, in module order then by range.

checked.description: Modules whose bodies were checked this run.

reused.description: Modules whose stored unit was read instead.
